statistical_tests.h0: Median daily sales under promotion are less than or equal to median sales without promotion.
statistical_tests.h1: Median daily sales under promotion are significantly higher than non-promotional days.
statistical_tests.business_interpretation: Promotions produce a statistically significant uplift in daily sales volume (p = 2.9027e-212, lift = +15.1%). NovaMart should prioritize tactical promo campaigns on high-margin categories.

statistical_tests.business_question: Does daily demand differ across store types (Hypermarket, Supermarket, Express)?
statistical_tests.h0: Daily demand distributions are identical across Hypermarket, Supermarket, and Express stores.
statistical_tests.h1: At least one store type has a significantly different demand distribution.
statistical_tests.business_interpretation: Daily sales demand differs significantly by store format (p = 3.9462e-19), with Hypermarket formats handling higher throughput than Express formats, requiring distinct inventory replenishment cadence.

statistical_tests.business_question: Is stock-out frequency significantly associated with promotional status?
statistical_tests.h0: Stock-out occurrence is statistically independent of promotional status.
statistical_tests.h1: Stock-out occurrence is significantly dependent on promotional campaigns.
statistical_tests.test_used: Chi-Square Test of Independence (with Yates continuity correction)
statistical_tests.business_interpretation: Promotional surge creates elevated demand spikes that amplify stock-out vulnerabilities (p = 2.5131e-02, Cramer's V = 0.0081). Supply chain reorder schedules must incorporate promotional calendars.
